_comment: Haunted-land cobble/grass blob-autotile (cobble dominant, grass intrudes). Row-major: 0=cobble 1=cobble_grass_n 2=cobble_grass_s 3=cobble_grass_e 4=cobble_grass_w 5=cobble_grass_nw 6=cobble_grass_ne 7=cobble_grass_sw 8=cobble_grass_se 9=grass(haunted, pure). Shares its pure cobble/grass tiles with haunted_grass_cobble.json for a seamless border between the two.
